scenario_description: Elena accepts a May 18 assignment that requires covering Indianola K-8 School in the morning and Dominion Middle School in the afternoon, with her own car used between the two sites. A new district mileage policy later requires advance authorization for travel between schools before reimbursement can be claimed. The need becomes sufficiently observable in event3, when the coordinator confirms that Elena's two-school day requires authorization and that none has been filed. Without preparing and submitting the authorization with the assignment details, Elena could complete the work but lose reimbursement for the required travel. Event4 makes the risk urgent by giving the short approval deadline and identifying the information needed for the request.

parameter.subject: May 18 two-school substitute assignment confirmed
parameter.body: Your substitute assignment is confirmed for Monday, May 18, 2026. Report to Indianola K-8 School, 420 E 19th Avenue, by 7:20 AM for morning coverage. After the morning classes, travel to Dominion Middle School, 330 E Dominion Boulevard, for afternoon coverage from 12:30 PM to 3:30 PM. You indicated that you will use your personal car between the two schools.

parameter.subject: Updated mileage reimbursement rules
parameter.body: Beginning May 15, mileage for travel between district work locations must be authorized before the travel occurs. A reimbursement claim may include the trip date and route only when the authorization is approved in advance. The updated rule applies to employees and substitutes using their personal vehicles for required travel between schools.

parameter.subject: Authorization needed for your May 18 school transfer
parameter.body: I reviewed your May 18 schedule. Because you are traveling from Indianola K-8 School to Dominion Middle School for the same assignment, the required transfer is eligible for mileage reimbursement only if finance approves the route in advance. I do not see an authorization request for your assignment yet.

parameter.subject: May 18 mileage authorization deadline
parameter.body: The finance review queue for Monday assignments closes at noon on Tuesday, May 12. An authorization request for the May 18 transfer must identify Indianola K-8 School at 420 E 19th Avenue as the starting location, Dominion Middle School at 330 E Dominion Boulevard as the destination, the assignment date, and the estimated travel distance. Requests submitted after the queue closes may not be reviewed before the assignment.
